answers.core: I think its a very simple thing to be addon and for peoples who is new to game developing it is confusing. Also saw one guy with the same error in  [Godot Forum](https://forum.godotengine.org/t/onready-returning-null/103048/6)
answers.workaround: Doesn't even need a script just copying and pasting InteractableArea with existing children solves the problem. So its not a necessisty but quality of life improvement.
